r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: All 5 constraints checked: (A) physics_region_no_evo_import: PASS — imports are src.physics.capability_envelope, src.physics.layer2.pooling, src.physics.longitudinal_fit, src.physics.physics_config, src.physics.physics_data_models only; grep for evo returns zero matches. (B) Single canonical execution path: PASS — CapabilityEnvelope.from_parameters(params, air_density, cfg) is the only call (line 532); no second inline scalar sim anywhere in the file. (C) Explicit as-of cutoff: PASS — target_round is a required named parameter with no default; _filter_causal raises ValueError with clear message if nothing qualifies; no silent fallback to latest/whole-season. (D) Honest covariance first-class: PASS (with caveat — see scrutiny point 2 below). Blob preferred over diagonal; _build_2x2_cov tries to parse the blob first, falls back to sigma^2 diagonal if invalid. Per-scalar pooled sigmas flow into all sub-parameter covariances. The most-recent-session blob selection is honest (it is a real measured covariance, not fabricated) — see scrutiny point 2 ruling. (E) py not python: PASS — all commands in handoff/evidence use py; no python invocations in the new code. SCRUTINY POINT 1 (clock proxy): APPROVE-with-tracked-triage. round_idx is monotone and always available in the store; causal ordering is PRESERVED (round 3 always > round 2; the filter is clock <= target_round which is correct). The divergence from the upgrade_clock design (pool_driver.py line 113 uses upgrade_clock_fn) affects drift-rate MAGNITUDE only, not causal correctness. fit_drift is still called on the causal subset; it estimates step_var from the same subset, so the step_var units are self-consistent within this call. The as-of contract is intact. Triage candidate correctly filed by implementer. APPROVE-with-tracked-triage. SCRUTINY POINT 2 (covariance blob selection): APPROVE. _pick_representative_blob returns the most-recent valid 2x2 blob from the causal slice. This is a real measured covariance from actual data, not nominal/fabricated. The alternative (a pooled 2x2 blob) would require either a pooled-blob column in the store schema (not present) or computing it here from per-session blobs (deferred). The honest-covariance requirement is satisfied: the blob represents genuine correlations from the estimator; the fallback to sigma^2 diagonal is also real (from per-scalar pooled sigmas). This is an approximation-of-convenience, not a correctness break. Triage candidate filed. APPROVE.
